import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression

MAX_DRIVERS = 4

def design(feats):
    # Check if any feature shows significant association with outcome
    # using Welch's t-test (as in the stats table)
    p_values = []
    for fid in feats.ids:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        x = feats.x[:, col_idx]
        y = feats.y
        
        # Calculate mean difference for each group
        mean_y0 = np.mean(x[y == 0])
        mean_y1 = np.mean(x[y == 1])
        diff = mean_y1 - mean_y0
        
        # Welch's t-test
        n0 = np.sum(1 - y)
        n1 = np.sum(y)
        var0 = np.var(x[y == 0], ddof=1)
        var1 = np.var(x[y == 1], ddof=1)
        
        se = np.sqrt(var0/n0 + var1/n1)
        t_stat = diff / se if se > 0 else 0
        df = (var0/n0 + var1/n1)**2 / ((var0/n0)**2/(n0-1) + (var1/n1)**2/(n1-1))
        p_val = 2 * (1 - stats.t.cdf(abs(t_stat), df)) if df > 0 else 1
        
        p_values.append(p_val)
    
    # If all p-values > 0.05, claim no mechanism
    if all(p > 0.05 for p in p_values):
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Select top features by p-value
    sorted_indices = np.argsort(p_values)
    selected_features = [feats.ids[i] for i in sorted_indices[:10]]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    keep_features = []
    for fid in selected_features:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        x = feats.x[:, col_idx]
        is_duplicate = False
        for kept_fid in keep_features:
            kept_col_idx = feats.column(kept_fid)
            y = feats.x[:, kept_col_idx]
            corr = np.corrcoef(x, y)[0, 1]
            if abs(corr) >= 0.6:
                is_duplicate = True
                break
        if not is_duplicate:
            keep_features.append(fid)
    
    # Fit logistic regression to see which features actually contribute
    X = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in keep_features]]
    model = LogisticRegression(fit_intercept=True, max_iter=1000)
    model.fit(X, feats.y)
    
    # Get coefficients (absolute values) to rank importance
    coef_abs = np.abs(model.coef_[0])
    sorted_coef_indices = np.argsort(coef_abs)[::-1]
    
    # Return top features that are drivers (causal)
    drivers = tuple([keep_features[i] for i in sorted_coef_indices[:min(MAX_DRIVERS, len(keep_features))]])
    
    # All features that entered the model
    columns = tuple(keep_features)
    
    # No products since we're not looking for interactions
    products = ()
    
    # Weighted score based on coefficients
    loadings = dict(zip(keep_features, model.coef_[0]))
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
